notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Changes

 Cut out parts of tutorial and sped up tutorial.


Fixes

 UI alignment fix.
 Spelling/grammar fix.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Additions

More explanation of the game in the tutorial level.
Shortcut to the manual from the title screen main menu.
Idling on the title screen main menu for 10 seconds will play 1 of 2 gameplay video demonstrations ( Just like old classic games do )

Changes

Balanced 'Survival' mode by increasing the frequency of power-ups that spawn.
